description: The plot illustrates the maximum activation value across layers for different components of a model. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 21, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Max Activation Value” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. A dashed blue line, labeled “attn_output”, begins at approximately 100 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively constant around 1400 until layer 10, and then declines to approximately 200 at layer 21. A dotted green line, labeled “attn_residual”, starts at approximately 100 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, declines to approximately 100 at layer 7, and remains near 100 until layer 21. A dashed orange line, labeled “ffn_output”, begins at approximately 100 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, remains relatively constant around 1400 until layer 10, and then declines to approximately 400 at layer 21. A solid red line, labeled “ffn_residual”, starts at approximately 100 at layer 0, rises sharply to approximately 1400 at layer 5, declines to approximately 100 at layer 7, and remains near 100 until layer 21.
